programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Dildaar
programme.desc: Guru, a carefree lad who is unemployed, falls in love with Priya. However, when he approaches her brother Nanda to ask for her hand in marriage, he rejects him and offers him money to forego his love.

programme.title: Ek Aur Hero The Dashing
programme.desc: After the death of their eldest brother, Babloo and the other three brothers develop hatred towards women. However, things take a turn when Babloo falls in love with Pooja.

programme.title: Super Shastri
programme.desc: Subramanya, son of a Brahmin priest, falls in love with Sowmya, the daughter of a village criminal. To impress her family, Subramanya decides to become a gangster.

programme.title: Pighalta Aasman
programme.desc: Delhi-based businesswoman Arti Singh travels to Kashmir to claim her land from Suraj Arora. Soon after Arti and Suraj fall in love with each other, she learns that her friend Anu too loves him.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgement...
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: James Pondu
programme.desc: James and Pandu are porters and very good friends. They get appointed by the owner and the manager of a chit fund to steal money, but later fall into a trap.

programme.title: Ek Taqatwar The Mighty
programme.desc: Raju, a thug, falls in love with a girl and gives up his corrupt practices. However, he gets framed for a major scam that brings out his dark past, sabotaging his relationship.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Lashkar
programme.desc: Anand, a professor, meddles with Sangram Singh, a gangster, but he gets acquitted in court. When Sangram seeks revenge, Anand joins hands with a policeman to defeat the crook.

programme.title: Kab? Kyoon? Aur Kahan?
programme.desc: Asha, a rich man's daughter, is arrested for her uncle's murder. Inspector Anand, who loves her, tries his best to solve the case and save her.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Jung ka Maidan
programme.desc: Ashok and Anand are best friends in spite of being very different. When Ashok accidentally becomes the reason for a misunderstanding in Anand's wedding procedures, he tries to fix it.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Arundhati
programme.desc: An idol from a temple in Kshetram is hidden in a forest to protect it from invaders. The Rayulu family tries hard to reinstate it back to the temple in order to complete an old ritual.

programme.title: Hum Hai Champions
programme.desc: Mallika is blackmailed by a dangerous don to fall in love with his rival's son Panda and eventually murder him. However, Panda is already madly in love with her and does not see what is coming.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Anu and Siddhu are in love and Siddhu turns up when Anu's family camps in a tiger sanctuary for a holiday. Unexpectedly, a sandalwood smuggler takes several members as hostages.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Humse Hai Zamana
programme.desc: Ravindra and Gowri, who belong to rival factions, are sworn enemies. After being imprisoned and learning that his brother was killed, Gowri goes after Ravindra's sister, Preeti, as revenge.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Asmaan Se Ooncha
programme.desc: Inspector Malik transfers to Mumbai along with his family and sets out on a mission to catch King, an underworld leader. However, a shocking revelation changes the course of their lives.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Antim Nyay
programme.desc: Jay Singh encounters Seema while struggling to seek justice for his deceased father. As the couple attempts to live a happy life, unforeseen circumstances invite more troubles.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Prithipal Singh...A Story
programme.desc: Disappointed with his Olympic bronze medal, Prithipal Singh quits hockey and joins a university. However, things get worse for him when he is accused of murdering a student.

programme.title: Kaise Kahoon Ke...Pyaar Hai
programme.desc: Karan, a burglar, wishes to permanently leave his profession when he falls in love with Priya. They decide to get married, but Karan finds out that he has cancer.

programme.title: Insaniyat
programme.desc: In order to combat terrorism, Inspector Amar has to convince two local crime lords, divided by religion, to work together. He also learns that being an honest cop has its own price.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: 16 December
programme.desc: Four Indian Revenue Service officers are assigned to intercept and arrest a group of Pakistani terrorists. The terrorists plot to detonate a nuclear bomb in New Delhi and the IRS must stop them.

programme.title: 100 Days of Love
programme.desc: Despite their strained history as children, a columnist falls in love with his schoolmate when they meet after years. Just as he decides to win her heart, he learns that she is engaged to another man.

programme.title: Marshal
programme.desc: A young man puts his life on the line to investigate a hospital run by a crime syndicate that performs various unethical procedures on helpless patients.

programme.title: Daring Ashique
programme.desc: Cheenu, a studious boy, and Lakshmi, the village landlord's daughter, study in the same college and fall for each other. However, her brother-in-law covets her and poses problems for the couple.

programme.title: Johny I Love You
programme.desc: Suraj Singh, a former bandit, relocates to a small hillside after the death of his wife, Savitri. He changes his son Raju's name to Johny to save him from the wrath of his former partner.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Khel
programme.desc: Three fraudsters trick a rich elderly woman, Sulakshana, who is desperately looking for her long-lost grandchild, in order to acquire her estate and property.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: Ohm Shanti Oshaana
programme.desc: Pooja Mathew, a spirited young girl, dreams about marrying only for love. Thus, she stops at nothing to impress Giri, who saved her once from a group of unruly men.

programme.title: Khatarnak Khel
programme.desc: A young girl loses her parents in an accident due to illegal bike racers in Chennai. She soon sets out to exact revenge on the racer responsible for her parents' death.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Naya Kadam
programme.desc: In a village ruled by Madhukar and Jaggu, who deprive the people of education so they can easily oppress them, Ramu manages to educate himself secretly with the help of a school teacher.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Chak De Phatte Hockey Ke..
programme.desc: Prabhakaran, a former hockey player, helps a local team save their ground by training them to win a match against the Pondicherry team. However, a corrupt politician has his eyes set on the ground.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Big Tunes - Bad Hair! Top 20

programme.title: Classic Rock Day!
programme.desc: 24 hours of rock classics & anthems! We guarantee AC/DC, Nirvana, Queen, Meat Loaf, Bon Jovi & much more!

programme.title: Guns N' Roses: Rock Icons
programme.desc: An hour of Anthems and the biggest rock songs from rock legends Guns N' Roses!

programme.title: Monsters Of 70s Rock!

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: So Hard To Say Goat-Bye: The Schroeders castrate an aggressive alpaca, bring a mama dog back from the brink of death and save a horse from bleeding out. (S3, ep 1)

programme.title: Wild Florida
programme.desc: Croc Coast: Explore the wild inhabitants of Florida's coral islands, lush mangroves and sandy beaches which include, crocodiles, sharks, rattlesnakes and deadly birds of prey. (2 of 2) 7+

programme.title: Wild Namib: Land Of Extremes
programme.desc: Explore Africa's southern coastal desert, where fur seals and penguins divide their time between the sandy shore and the icy sea water and ostrich and hyena roam the windswept dunes. 7+

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Urban Jaws: Investigate a devastating shark bite in Australia, hunting for clues in attacks across the globe before analysing the data in a cutting-edge lab. 12+. (S2, ep 1)

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines with Chris Barrie
programme.desc: 1910s: Chris looks back at 100 years of technology and inventions, beginning with the decade that produced the new weapons, trucks, planes and ships used in WWI. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: The Stricken Chicken: Dr. Oakley sees two stubborn muskoxen and a particularly wily coyote. A badly burned dog receives an innovative, if fishy, new treatment. (S7, ep 6)

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Chapter Three: The Greatest: Reunited with his family, Kio faces a harsh new reality. One fateful mistake changes everything, forcing the young lion to fend for himself. (3 of 4) 7+

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Chapter Four: To Be A King: Kio discovers a new kingdom, but powerful rivals stand in his way. To claim a pride and a future, he must fight for his crown. (4 of 4) 7+

programme.title: Wild Mediterranean
programme.desc: Untamed Coasts: A wealth of wildlife, including some of the world's most remarkable survivors, call the serene waters along the Mediterranean coastline home. 7+ (2 of 2)

programme.title: Swamp Men
programme.desc: One Bad Gator: Staff dice with death as they make three alligators move home. The park takes in a huge and dangerous bull gator. But can its staff contain the aggressive beast? (S3, ep2) 7+

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Moonlight Mayhem: Time is short and the police pile on the pressure when Thord struggles to get a 16-wheeler back on the road. (S5, ep 7) 7+

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: War Games: Mmamotse has turned the kingdom upside down but her legacy now depends on a princess taking the throne. Dikeledi prepares her cheetah cubs to cross enemy territory. (S3, ep 4) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: Kindergarten Terror: Siouxsie comes face-to-face with a green mamba and Simon gets a narrow escape. Plus, the pair catch two bizarre snakes that don't belong in Durban. (S6, ep 5) 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Hayfield of Dreams: After getting the tractor stuck in mud, Charles and Ben need a quick solution to plant hayseed. Meanwhile, Dr Pol helps set up beehive colonies. U. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: How Now Smelly Cow: Dr Pol and Charles are already on their way to Gross Dairy Farm for an emergency call to help a feisty cow with a twisted stomach and a foul stench. 12+. (S3, ep 10)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Dances with Dachshunds: Dr Oakley treats an off-the-grid dachshund and an emotional support pig, and reunites reindeer siblings. (S8, 15) 7+

programme.title: Life Below Zero: First Alaskans
programme.desc: Veins of Alaska: In preparation for winter, Alaska Natives gather valuable resources along the rivers of their homelands. 7+. (S3, ep 16)

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Down and Derby: The staff face plenty of ups and downs, as a horse in rapidly worsening health and a calf with poor chance of survival take their toll on the team. 7+. (S2, ep 4)

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: Columbus
programme.desc: Tiger Queen: Are you ready to meet a daredevil flying goats, adorable cheetah cubs, a cranky female tiger, a lethal king cobra and a rhino that paints?! (S3, ep 5) 7+

programme.title: Snakes In The City
programme.desc: It's Simon and Siouxsie to the rescue, when a black mamba slithers into a kitchen, a huge cobra is spotted in a shopping mall and a mechanic finds a lethal snake in his toolbox. (S3, ep 5)

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Wild Assassins: From the Ethiopian wolf's hunting techniques to the Verreaux's eagle's highspeed aerial pursuits, Africa's predators are perfectly adapted and utterly deadly. U. (S8, ep 6)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: More Than a Feline: A bona fide bevy of bovine awaits Dr Pol and Dr Nicole as they roll out to Clay Knob Farm for herd health checks. (S9, ep 4)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: You've Gotta be Kitten Me!: The Schroeders take on a goat with the spirit of a rock legend, who's ready to roll with its stones! (S3, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: World's Deadliest Whale
programme.desc: Intelligent and cultured, the killer whale dominates every ocean on earth. Discover how this top predator employs multiple killing techniques to become the World's Deadliest Whale. 7+

programme.title: World's Deadliest Jellyfish
programme.desc: World's Deadliest Jellyfish: Jellyfish can grow longer than a blue whale and are the deadliest creature on the planet. These are the world's deadliest jellyfish.

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Dangerous Forces: Diva uncovers a spate of shark bites from across the world, all happening within a few days - so the team tries to understand what connects them. 12+. (S2, ep 2)

programme.title: Britain's Greatest Machines with Chris Barrie
programme.desc: Trains: In the 1820s, transport evolved from foot and horse to the first passenger railway in just ten years. Chris discovers how trains changed British society. 7+

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: One Clever Bison: While Dr. Oakley awaits a litter of puppies, she hits the road to treat a stubborn bison and a moose with a respiratory issue. (S7, ep 7) 7+

programme.title: Secrets Of The Zoo: North Carolina
programme.desc: Roaring Success: As a senior bull elephant finds his 'zen', a big gator becomes an unwilling patient and a porcupine requires a dentist visit. (S1, ep 3) 7+

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Oceans: The series heads to crowded corals and stormy coasts as it explores the ocean creatures fighting to survive their constantly changing habitat. Bear Grylls narrates. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Mountains: Bear Grylls narrates a spectacular look at life for creatures in some of the most brutal environments on Earth. From Oscar-winning cinematographer Guillermo Navarro. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: Swamp Men
programme.desc: Most Wanted: Feisty gator 'Bad' begins to live up to his name. Meanwhile, a sick alligator undergoes surgery and staff learn that transporting an 800lb reptile is no mean feat. 7+(S3, ep 3)

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Tough at the Top: A drill rig hangs over a 15-metre cliff and Ole Henrik must make a life-threatening decision. (S5, ep 8) 7+

programme.desc: Ga Ba Goo Ba Ga (The Babblist): A fake "babblist" tries to scam parents by pretending to understand baby talk, while Tim attempts to sell magazines with Boss Baby's questionable help. (S2, ep 3)

programme.title: Popularity Papers
programme.desc: Pain in the Bat Mitzvah: Lydia's Bat Mitzvah is coming up, which means this is her opportunity to invite all the popular kids to her grand, out of this world party! (S1, ep 13)

programme.title: Rock Island Mysteries
programme.desc: Something Else In The Water: The gang discover a bottle of ancient perfume in an underwater shipwreck which causes Taylor and Lila to rapidly age. Now they must find an antidote. (S2, ep 5)

programme.title: Rock Island Mysteries
programme.desc: Dream A Little Dream: At a sleepover, Taylor dreams that Uncle Charlie is in danger and trying to contact her. Soon she discovers her friends are sharing the same dream. (S2, ep 6)

programme.title: Hunter Street
programme.desc: Quantum Problems and Dead Ends: Jennie and Anika hit a dead end with their investigation into the bunny's holocode device, while the hunt for the twins' dad reveals a new name. (S4, ep 4)

programme.title: Hunter Street
programme.desc: Sally Hunter: Oliver, Jasmyn and Evie head to a book signing hoping for some bio-dad names. Meanwhile 'Sally' has a difficult initiation test by Miss Lucas, putting her cover under strain. (S4, ep 3)

programme.title: House of Anubis
programme.desc: House of Sarcophagi: Eddie has a bad feeling. The Sibunas plant secret cameras and hear a strange voice calling for help. Mara and Willow plot revenge on cheating Jerome. (S3, ep22)

programme.title: House of Anubis
programme.desc: House of Possession: Jerome, Joy, Patricia and Alfie start acting very strangely. Jerome thinks he's been picked for a talent contest. KT wants answers and goes to the Gatehouse. (S3, ep23)

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Part 1 - A New Evil: Henry is trapped at home with his family while Captain Man heads out alone to save the founder of TwitFlash. Meanwhile, Charlotte and Schwoz put together a mystery. (S5, ep 6)

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Part 2 - A New Darkness: After a criminal steals Kid Danger's superpower and learns his identity, goons are sent to Henry's house. Jasper, Charlotte and Schwoz work to get his power back. (S5, ep 7)

programme.title: Popularity Papers
programme.desc: Skate Expectations: After being impressed by Chuck's skateboarding skills, Lydia tries her hand at skating to catch the school's attention - which has nothing to do with Chuck, of course. (S1, ep 17)

programme.title: Rock Island Mysteries
programme.desc: Frozen In Time: Party plans for Gillian and Faraz are interrupted when the group discovers that everyone on Rock Island keeps freezing - except them! And Raquel is unaffected too. (S2, ep 14)

programme.title: Rock Island Mysteries
programme.desc: Runaway Groom: It's the day of Gillian and Faraz's wedding when Faraz mysteriously disappears. (S2, ep 15)

programme.title: Jaisi Karni Waisi Bharni

programme.title: The Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: 1976. Drama. Director: George P Cosmatos. Stars Sophia Loren, Richard Harris, Burt Lancaster & Martin Sheen. Passengers of a European train can't escape after a deadly virus is planted.

programme.title: Dick Tracy Returns
programme.desc: 1938. Actions. Directors John English & William Witney. Stars Ralph Byrd, Lynn Roberts & Charles Middleton. Tracy battles spies and saboteurs in his efforts to bring to justice the Stark gang.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1957. Bullet from the Past. Director: Kenneth Hume. Stars Ballard Berkeley, Robert Sansom and Philippa Hyatt. An inspector investigates the shooting of a man connected to an old cold case. (S1, E20)

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Blind Man's Bluff. Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Hi Diddle Riddle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Neil Hamilton. The Riddler's twisted trail leads Batman to break the law and fall before the criminal charms of a beautiful Molehill Mob moll.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Smack in the Middle. 1966. Stars Adam West, Frank Gorshin & Jill St. John. The Riddler holds Robin hostage to lure Batman into a trap that could mean the end of the Caped Crusader.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Singing Violin. 1954. Stars Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Betty is being tormented by apparent hallucinations, so her fiancé calls Sherlock and Dr Watson.

programme.title: The Voice Of Merrill
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Starring Valerie Hobson, James Robertson Justice & Sam Kydd. A dying author frames a radio narrator for killing his secretary.

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout October.

programme.title: No Trace
programme.desc: 1950. Drama. Directed by John Gilling. Writer Robert Southley finds his lifestyle threatened by blackmail from a former US criminal associate. Stars Hugh Sinclair, Dinah Sheridan & John Laurie.

programme.title: The Crooked Sky
programme.desc: 1957. Crime drama directed by Henry Cass. An American detective & Scotland Yard must work together to crack a counterfeit gang. Stars Wayne Morris, Karin Booth and Anton Diffring.

programme.title: The Spider and the Fly
programme.desc: 1949. Crime. Directed by Robert Hamer. Stars Eric Portman, Nadia Gray & George Cole. An unusual love triangle develops between two criminals and a policeman on the eve of the first World War.

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: Trouble and Strife. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, John Cater & Maureen O'Brien. A woman from Starr's past, down on her luck, begs him to use his influence to obtain a job for her at the Bentinck.

programme.title: High Tide
programme.desc: 1980. Thriller. A man just released from prison for manslaughter heads to the West Country to solve the mystery behind his victim's cryptic last words. Stars Ian McShane, Wendy Morgan & John Bird.

programme.title: Look At Life Any Old Iron
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the people who prepare salvaged steel to be re-used, also with a glimpse at the steel foundries which melt it all down again.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Join Noel as he introduces the delightful musical comedy Squibs from 1935, and provides an insight into Julius Hagen's part in making the film.

programme.title: Squibs
programme.desc: 1935. Comedy. Directed by Henry Edwards. Stars Betty Balfour. A cockney flowerseller, Squibs (Balfour) with a father overwhelmed by gambling debts wins through with the help of assorted friends.

programme.title: Julius Hagen Season
programme.desc: Tune in to find out which brilliant Julius Hagen film will be shown next week.

programme.title: Strange But True?
programme.desc: Bigfoot/Ouija Boards. 1997. Michael Aspel speaks to Todd Neiss about his apparent bigfoot sighting and are Ouija boards just a bit of fun or more dangerous than we know?

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Loneliness. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Hilary Tindall & Rio Fanning. Brian and Ann both face the problems of loneliness. Meanwhile, the Hammonds are invited to Sir Neville's for a shooting party.

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Luger For Chesser. 1957. Stars Donald Gray, Sarah Lawson & Gladys Boot. A man with no friends or enemies is killed. The finger of suspicion points at his ex-wife who has come into his money.

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: Episode 20. 1975. Roger Whittaker and Saffron perform 'New World In The Morning', 'The Seasons Come and the Seasons Go', and Helen Shapiro performs 'Lean On Me'.

programme.title: The Killing Of Sister George
programme.desc: 1968. Drama. Directed by Robert Aldrich. Stars Beryl Reid, Susannah York, Coral Browne, Patricia Medina & Ronald Fraser. An aging actress faces the loss of her popular television role.

programme.title: Love and Pain and the Whole Damn Thing
programme.desc: 1973. Comedy. Directed by Alan J. Pakula. Stars Maggie Smith, Timothy Bottoms & May Heatherly. A prim English spinster meets a college drop-out while on a bus trip through Spain.

programme.title: The Madame Gambles
programme.desc: 1951. Comedy. The owner of a dress shop gambles the shop away to her bookie who inherits, not only the shop, but the manager. Directed by Maclean Rogers. Starring Richard Hearne and Petula Clark.

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed Super Sleuth? 1964. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway & Regis Toomey. Four world renowned cops and a US private eye become suspect in another sleuth's murder.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Fine Feathered Finks. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith & Lewis Charles. Disguised as Bruce Wayne, Batman infiltrates the Penguin's umbrella factory in an attempt to track him down.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Penguin's a Jinx. 1966. Stars Adam West, Lewis Charles & Burgess Meredith. Narrowly escaping a fiery death, Batman and Robin figure out the Penguin's next move is to kidnap a famous actress.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Thistle Killer. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford & Archie Duncan. Sherlock helps hunt down a killer of women who leaves three thistles next to each body.

programme.title: Road to Bali
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy. Directed by Hal Walker. Stars Bing Crosby, Bob Hope & Dorothy Lamour. Two vaudeville performers accept diving work in Bali and find treasure, love and trouble along the way.

programme.title: Born Of The Sea
programme.desc: 1949. A mysterious baby is found in a boat at sea, along with a charming portrait of a community in Coverack. Where is he from? Stars Dorothea Paul Directed by Anthony Mavrogordato.

programme.title: Stars In Your Eyes
programme.desc: 1956. Musical. Directed by Maurice Elvey. Stars Nat Jackley, Pat Kirkwood & Bonar Colleano. A group of talented entertainers band together to purchase a run-down theatre to put on a show.

programme.title: Arsenal Stadium Mystery
programme.desc: 1939. Mystery. Director: Thorold Dickinson. Stars Leslie Banks, Greta Gynt, Ian McLean. Poison, death and mystery set at the Arsenal Stadium. Detective Slade is called to solve the crime.

programme.title: The Edgar Wallace Mystery Theatre
programme.desc: Strangler's Web. 1965. Directed by John Llewellyn Moxey. Stars John Stratton & Pauline Munro. What appears to be a cut-and-dried case of a murder of a showgirl becomes very complicated.

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Byzantine Treasure. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. Discovering King John's mothers stolen money, Robin embarks to return it in a potentially dangerous mission.

programme.title: Patricia Dainton Presents...
programme.desc: Tread Softly. Exclusive interview with Patricia Dainton who discusses her time on this film and her career in general. (S1, E01)

programme.title: Tread Softly
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by David MacDonald. Stars Frances Day, Patricia Dainton & John Bentley. The star of a musical walks out before curtain up, but the show must go on, in a 'Haunted Theatre'.

programme.title: Patricia Dainton Presents...
programme.desc: Outro. Thank you for watching from Patricia Dainton who wishes us a fond farewell and looks back on her life in film. (S1, E08)

programme.title: The Cheaters
programme.desc: Green for Danger. 1962. Stars John Ireland, Robert Ayres & Margaretta Scott. Mrs Osborne's emeralds have been stolen, and she wants them back. John Hunter tries to track the thief down.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: 1971. Hazard. Stars Keith Drinkel & Jeff Shankley. Out in the Western Desert, Phillip comes to the aid of a Sergeant stuck in an abandoned vehicle riddled with mines. (S2, E11)

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Sarah. Stars: Susie Blake, Maureen Lipman, Sam Dastor. New Year's Eve can be very lonely for people in the rooms, so Sarah opts to throw a party.

programme.title: Scales of Justice
programme.desc: 1967. Payment In Kind. Stars Edgar Lustgarten & Maxine Audley. Debt collectors suggest 'payment in kind' after the wife of a businessman falls behind on hire purchase payments. (S1, E13)

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: A Place of Safety. 1964. Stars Norman Bird & Johnny Sekka. A bailiff is attacked after trying to evict residents of a poverty stricken building. The team must investigate the volatile situation.

programme.title: Public Eye
programme.desc: 1973. Detective & Mystery Drama. Home & Away. Stars Alfred Burke, Barbara Young, Bryan Pringle. Madge Reading turns to Marker when she suspects there is another woman in her husband's life.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Welcome down into the Cellar Club where tonight Caroline Munro has a terrifying treat with the 1971 thriller Fright starring Honor Blackman and Dennis Waterman.

programme.title: Fright (1971)
programme.desc: 1971. Thriller. Directed by Peter Collinson. Stars Honor Blackman, Susan George & Dennis Waterman. A young babysitter is terrorised by a bloodthirsty escapee of a psychiatric asylum.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: As the end of this week's Cellar Club draws near, Caroline Munro is here to talk about what is coming up next week.

programme.title: Horror of Frankenstein
programme.desc: 1971. Horror. Directed by Jimmy Sangster. Stars Dennis Price, Kate O'Mara & Ralph Bates. Young Victor Frankenstein inherits his father's title, his castle and his taste for grisly experiments.

programme.title: Three Came Home
programme.desc: 1950. True story of a woman imprisoned in several Japanese war camps. She struggles to protect her young son. Stars Claudette Colbert.

programme.title: The Hi-jackers
programme.desc: 1963. Drama. Director: Jim O'Connolly. Stars Anthony Booth & Jacqueline Ellis. A lorry driver meets Shirley at a cafe and offers her a lift. His truck carrying valuable whiskey is later hijacked.

programme.title: Look At Life The Hat Trick
programme.desc: 1963. A look at the hats manufactured in Britain every year, with a glance at the intriguing facts and figures about the millions of hats made.

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Deception. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Marjorie Stewart & Ann Stephens. Only two out of the three Hadley sisters have suitors. The older sister makes up a romance and ends up getting blackmailed.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Joker is Wild. 1966. Stars Adam West, Dick Curtis & Cesar Romero. The Joker has escaped from prison and plots to design his own utility belt to combat the Caped Crusader.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Batman is Riled. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Cesar Romero. The Joker takes Batman and Robin back to his lair, demanding that the S.S. Gotham be handed over to him or he will behead them.

programme.title: Low Water
programme.desc: 1966. Directed by Tom Scott Robson. In North East England, we take a look at the lives of the men that make a living collecting coal washed-up on beaches from underground seams.

programme.title: The Drum
programme.desc: 1938. War. Directed by Zoltan Korda. Stars Sabu, Raymond Massey & Roger Livesey. When the Khan of Tokot is murdered, his killer, the evil Prince Ghul, plots an uprising against British rule.

programme.title: Runaround
programme.desc: 1981. Presented by Mike Reid. Prizes include a pocket calculator, an auto transporter set & a BMX bike. This episode features Model T Fords with archive film clip of factory and more.

programme.title: Legend of the Hidden City
programme.desc: 1997. Stars Brendan Pollecutt, Fezile Mpela & Robert Finlayson. Kabeth is released as prisoner and assigned the role of a Junior Scribe. Meanwhile, Morgan plots to get Marek out of prison.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: Boy Slaves. 1958. Stars: Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. Can Tell trust the word of his enemy? He must, if he's to obtain the release of young boys whom Gessler is holding.

programme.title: Hawkeye & the Last of the Mohicans
programme.desc: Washington Story. 1957. Directed by Sam Newfield. Stars John Hart, Lon Chaney Jr. & Rodney Bunker. Surveyor George Washington aids a woman whose land grant is threatened by a wicked innkeeper.

programme.title: The Lone Ranger
programme.desc: Lone Ranger Fights On. 1949. Stars Jay Silverheels, Clayton Moore & John Hart. The origin of the Lone Ranger's horse Silver and his use of silver bullets is explained.

programme.title: Supercar
